name: hyprland
title: Hyprland
description: Native Hyprland helpers for Vicinae: switch windows, swap the Catppuccin theme, and capture the screen.
author: jjruiz

commands.name: switch-window
commands.title: Switch Window
commands.subtitle: Hyprland
commands.description: List open Hyprland windows (most-recent first) and focus one.

commands.name: switch-theme
commands.title: Switch Theme
commands.subtitle: Catppuccin
commands.description: Swap the central Catppuccin flavor (drives your existing theme switcher).

commands.title: Capture
commands.subtitle: Screenshot · Record
commands.description: Screenshot, record the screen, OCR text, scan a QR code or pick a color (dotfiles capture-* scripts).
